# Open Institutional AI Readiness Framework (OIARF v2.0.0)
> SafeAI.report is the open-access portal hosting the Open Institutional AI Readiness Framework (OIARF v2.0.0) and the A4-ALAM Literacy Matrix.

## System Metadata
- Framework: Open Institutional AI Readiness Framework (OIARF)
- Version: 2.0.0-OIARF
- Academic DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21516198
- Author: Adel El Bouzagaoui
- Methodology: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA)
- Portal: https://safeai.report
- Assessment Engine: https://safeai.report/readiness
- Specification Repository: https://github.com/neurounfold-collab/safeai-report
- Operator languages: English · French · Spanish · Arabic (quadlingual; Arabic UI is RTL)
- Runtime weight authority: src/features/readiness/data/oiarfAssessment.js

## Languages (Quadlingual)
Operator UI, exam matrices, and SEO hreflang ship as **EN / FR / ES / AR**. Arabic uses `dir="rtl"` document architecture.

Arabic character tokenization compute-cost overhead (**+300% to +600%** relative to Latin-script baselines) is modeled exclusively under **Dimension 8 (Operational Readiness)** as a technical resource-allocation efficiency metric. It is **not** an A4-ALAM literacy competency criterion.

## The 8 OIARF Dimensions
Runtime MCDA weights \(W_d\) (sum = 1.00):

1. Leadership (Weight: 0.14)
2. Governance (Weight: 0.14)
3. AI Literacy & A4-ALAM Competencies (Weight: 0.15)
4. Technology (Weight: 0.11)
5. Data Readiness (Weight: 0.12)
6. Risk & Compliance (Weight: 0.14)
7. Workforce Culture (Weight: 0.10)
8. Operational Readiness (Weight: 0.10) — includes Arabic tokenization compute-cost overhead as a technical efficiency metric only

## Mathematical Composite
Isr = Sum(W_d * D_d) for d = 1 to 8.

A4-ALAM literacy exam composite (role-adaptive): Sc = Sum(w_i * P_i) for pillars P1–P4. Runtime cohort vectors (api/grade-exam.js): ExL [0.30, 0.30, 0.20, 0.20] · CLL [0.10, 0.50, 0.20, 0.20] · OEL [0.40, 0.10, 0.40, 0.10]. Institutional certification threshold: 85%.

## Integrity Layer
- Engine: WaqfLedger Open-Access Consortium Engine
- Log endpoint: https://waqfledger-api.vercel.app/api/v1/ledger/log-compliance
- Verification: SHA-256 tamper-evident hash receipts
- Data Policy: Zero-data retention (processed in-memory at the edge).
